mail_review.situation: Sanjay 是两年里一步一步走完筛子的人：2024-06 问 2.5G SFP 环网 + 120W 电源，Simon 直说「honestly we are a trading company… realtek chip」，他没走；2025-04 一次问三款（4/8/12+ 口 PoE 带 NMS 口）并问质保与测试证书，Simon 报 $110/$125；2025-10 要 QC 实验室照片和 PDF 目录；2025-11-24 拿出一张标书：带 4 口交换的 MC、SC/PC 双纤、-20~+65℃，中标可到 1,000 pcs，流程「规格审批 → 样品审批 → 供货」。Alan 先说没有正好的型号，再给 STI-140GE $30（含双纤模块）与 DIN 导轨 Meanwell 电源 $10；Sanjay 当天要 2+2 台样品、PayPal、发广州货代，并要 WeChat 快速沟通——Alan 把 WeChat 交给 Simon。12-01 付款。之后邮件无一封：标书结果、样品评测、1,000 台——仓库全无。
mail_review.need: 标书：工业 MC/4 口交换（1 光 SC/PC + 4 电，非 PoE，非管理，-20~+65℃）+ DIN 电源；日常：工业 PoE 整线替代其在售 ONV（研究档）。
mail_review.breakpoint: 没有断点，是「断档」：从邮件转到 WeChat 后仓库失明 11 个月。按 C9「邮件是档案、WhatsApp/WeChat 是现场」，这里需要 Simon 把标书结果补一句进来。

mail_review.situation: 新加坡 Resonant Networks（Au Wai Choon、Hairomee）2025-03 ISP 测试 10G MultiGig 通过，要捆绑低价 IP 摄像头「thousands together with the switch」；7 月客户评估拖延、嫌贵（附 TP-Link 多千兆零售价）；11-11「lost to TP-Link… about half the buy price from you」；Simon 答 $100/台做不到。2026-02/06/09 Simon 三次推送，6-22 对方仅礼貌回复。**B 级里来信最多的户，走完了验证却败在 Marvell 与 TP-Link 的价差上。**
mail_review.need: ISP 家用/SOHO 10G MultiGig（100M–10G）接入交换机 + 捆绑摄像头，量级千台，目标成本 ≈ TP-Link 零售价的一半以下。
mail_review.breakpoint: C6：Marvell 线做不到 ISP 零售级价格；这是「芯片线 ≠ 市场」而非谈判失误。

saga_now.p1: Realtek/HRUI 多千兆机已经卖过他 1 台（STC-08XGWE $185，PO SGP250051 2024-08）；2026-10 对外价 STC-05XGWE 5×10G 网管 $138 / STC-08XGWE $193 / STC-08XGE 非管理 $181.5 / STC-18XGDGE 1×10G + 8×2.5G $50.1（`data/hrui_STC对照表.csv`）——比 2024 报的 $145/$200/$170 还高，ISP 价格敏感无解，不推；等有 ≤$100 多千兆方案再触达
saga_now.price: 不报价（当前线做不到 $100）；历史报价（邮件原话，老汇率）：2024-07-21 STC-08XGE 170usd / 200usd；2024-07-03 ；2024-07-02 STC-18XGDGE 50usd；2024-08-21 185usd；2024-09 客户复述的 Saga 报价：5 口管理 $145 / 8 口管理 $200 / 8 口非管理 $170（STC-08XGWE 演示机 $185）；群发里他已看到的价（续，第 66 批全量复核）：2024-12-11 $300（48 Port PoE Managed Switch）
saga_now.why: C3：ISP 千台级是「拼命单」且价格主导｜毛利复盘：一单 22.6%（ZX-SWTGW2C80N 成本 1,040，代采）——正常
gaps: HRUI 线是否有 2.5G/10G MultiGig 低价机型可对 TP-Link——查 `价格主表_HRUI.csv`/规格书后再定

draft_en.body:
Hi Thu,

Following up on the 24-port PoE switch I mentioned when the MC1000SC03 converters shipped (DHL 8604097423 - please let me know they arrived in good shape).

STC-424XGGPM-280W: 24 x 10/100/1000 PoE+ (802.3af/at, 280 W budget) + 4 x 1G/2.5G/10G SFP+, L2+ managed (Web/CLI/SNMP), Marvell AC5. Price: $194 USD EXW per unit (snapshot 2026-10-22, valid 15 days). Vi-Link logo and front-panel printing are free, same as the converters, and a single sample unit is fine to start - sample cost is credited to your first order.

One question: is this switch for your own Vi-Link label, or for a specific end-customer project?

Best regards,
Simon
Saga Telecom - PoE / industrial switch OEM-ODM supplier (neutral packing available)
https://sagatele.com/

draft_en.subject: Re: PoE not powering on battery — did 7.5 change anything?
draft_en.body:
Hi, Chris,

Two loose ends from March that we never closed, sorry about that.

1. PoE not coming up after the switch sat on low battery for a couple of months — did the ports come back after the firmware 7.5 update, or is it still reproducible? If it is, send me the diagnostics package again and I will sit with engineering on it until we have an answer, not a "please check".
2. SSH terminal type (xterm-256color) — still not configurable on this build; I will tell you honestly when it changes rather than promise a date.

One question: on battery power, what is the DC input voltage at the switch when PoE fails to come up? That decides whether this is a PoE budget rule or a bug.

Thank you.
Alan

draft_en.subject: Re: 2x10G + 4x2.5G media converter — is 1,000/2,000 pcs still on the 2027 roadmap?
draft_en.body:
Hi, Frederik,

Thank you for the 6th order; the 20 units ship with original SmartByte names and SNMP strings as you asked.

On the FTTH 1G-to-10G upgrade: the 2x10G + 4x2.5G lite-managed unit is not a Marvell AC5 product, so we cannot derive it from the switch line. It is doable as a Realtek-based design (the RTL8373 class you mentioned), but only worth opening against a real volume.

One question: if we bring you a sample at a unit price in the range you had in mind, is 1,000 pcs for the first batch and ~2,000 per year still real for 2027, and what is the ceiling price per unit for your business case?

Thank you.
Simon

Merhaba,

Daha önce konuştuğumuz 100 adetlik endüstriyel fiber switch (2× SFP + 8× GE) talebi hâlâ açık mı?

Tek sorum: diğer tedarikçi hangi spesifikasyon/fiyatla kazandı? Bilirsek boşuna yazmayız.

Alan Yan
Saga Telecom

Last May you asked for bypass industrial switches (4x4 and 2x2). The $280 figure then was a placeholder; here are the actual numbers:

Alan

draft_en.subject: Re: DI order #1 (Nov 2024) — still worth shipping?
draft_en.body:
Hi Sergiy,

Two years ago your first test order (DI order #1, 20 Nov 2024) stopped on the question of who we are. The plain answer today: Saga is an engineering-led supplier — the Marvell managed line is our own platform (firmware, web GUI with your logo, feature roadmap), the low-cost unmanaged items are sourced from partner factories under our QC. We do not pretend to own the SMT line.

One question: are the Marvell items in that BO still worth shipping with your label, 7–10 working days after payment, as quoted then? If yes, I will re-issue the proforma at current prices; if no, I will close the file.

Best regards,
Simon
Saga Telecom · sagatele.com

draft_en.subject: Re: Broadcom-based solution — straight answer, and the one thing we can offer
draft_en.body:
Hi, Mark,

Straight answer to your April 2025 question: we do not build on Broadcom, and I should not have hinted otherwise in February. Our ranges are Marvell (access) and CENTEC (full L3: OSPF/BGP, MPLS, VXLAN/EVPN, MLAG).

For an ITS-hardened 10G optical aggregation role the CENTEC 24x10G + 2x100G L3 unit is the relevant box; it is quoted per project (DC power, MA license options).

One question: is "Broadcom" written into your customers' ITS specs, or would a CENTEC full-L3 unit qualify if it clears your lab test? If the former, I will stop sending you switch mail; if the latter, I will send the spec sheet and a test-unit price.

Thank you.
Alan

Hi,

Alan

draft_en.subject: Re: RF-GP2803PGM — a like-for-like Marvell unit, priced
draft_en.body:
Tomasz,

One line, since none of my earlier mails got a reply: your RF-GP2803PGM (8× GbE PoE + 2× SFP, industrial, managed) maps 1:1 to our STI-288DGGPM — Marvell AC5, L2+, -40~75°C, 240 W PoE budget, DIN-rail.

List is USD 137.5 EXW (snapshot 2026-10-17, valid 15 days); your own label and web UI are possible from small lots.

Only question: what landed cost and lead time does N-Net give you today? If we cannot beat both, I will stop writing.

Alan Yan
Saga Telecom

draft_en.subject: Re: EN 18031 / supplier documents — wired switches are outside RED scope
draft_en.body:
Hi, Mats, hi Anders,

Your document request from November: EN 18031 is the harmonised standard under the Radio Equipment Directive, and our Ethernet switches and media converters contain no radio, so RED/EN 18031 does not apply to them. What applies, and what we hold:

- CE Declaration of Conformity (EMC + LVD), RoHS, REACH — attached
- FCC, UKCA — attached
- ISO 9001 / ISO 14001: held by our manufacturing partner (the certificate carries the factory's legal name); copy on request

One question: is this sufficient for your supplier file, and who at Direktronik owns sourcing of active equipment (switches/MC) so I address the right person next time?

Thank you.
Alan

All -40 to +75 C, CE/RoHS/FCC; 4-7 working days ex-works, i.e. 10-15 days to Istanbul by air.

Hi, Lukasz,

In October 2025 we quoted the 1G SFP media converter (1x SFP + 1x GbE, DC 5 V) at $13 USD, MOQ 1, and then did not follow up properly. Copying Bartosz.

One question: is the Lanberg media-converter refresh still planned for 2027, and would a CE-PSU 1G SFP MC in the 13-USD class go into it?

Thank you.
Alan

draft_en.body:
Hi, Nate,

In April 2025 you asked for a small switch with about 8 x 10G copper ports plus 2-4 x 10G SFP+, and we said "not on the list"; in September we quoted the 24-SFP unit instead, which was not what you asked for.

Two units now match, both on our commercial (Realtek) line, neutral brand, AC input, 1U:
- 8 x 10G multi-gig copper (100M/1G/2.5G/5G/10G) + 4 x 10G SFP+, web-managed (VLAN, IGMP snooping, port stats): $204 USD EXW
- 8 x 10G multi-gig copper, unmanaged: $181.5 USD EXW
(2026-10 price table, valid 15 days from this mail; 1-year warranty on the commercial line (3 years on industrial models).)

If it must be full L2+/L3 managed, the smallest managed 10GBASE-T unit is 24 x 10G copper + 2 x 100G on the CENTEC line (quoted at $1,700 USD in July 2026 to another customer; lead time confirmed at order).

One question: for your San Antonio projects, is the 8 x 10G + 4 x SFP+ web-managed unit enough, or do you need CLI/SNMP management on it?

Thank you.
Alan

draft_en.body:
Levent, quick one on the 88 × STI-288DGGPM + 240W Meanwell PSU (quoted Oct 3: 875 + 250 RMB/pc, same box as last order): when do you expect the PO and the deposit?

I will block the production slot the day it lands — same ANW label format, serial numbers and packing as STSC20250619007, so no new confirmations are needed from your side. If the quantity or the PSU option changes, just tell me the new number and I will re-issue the PI the same day.

Separately (no rush): once this batch ships I would like to put one CENTEC L3 unit in your Ankara test depot before the next Turk Telekom cycle — we can talk after the PI.

Simon

mail_review.breakpoint: 没有断点；风险是 MQTT 对接若需要 Saga 侧固件开发，会撞「不做 SDK/API」边界（E2）——MQTT 上报属固件功能而非 SDK，需 Simon 与 SmartByte 确认 7.5.x 是否已有（不由代理问 Peter）。 新增：电源板四项改版是 PCB 级 ODM——HRUI/SmartByte 侧是否愿为 12 台/单的量开板（Angora 的 PC0012 代工询问也停在同一处），要先问 Peter 的 MOQ 而不是先答应 James。

draft_en.body:
For the MQTT setup, what exactly does SCOUT need from the switch side — periodic port/PoE status publish, or alarms only? (And on the power-board rework: which of the four requests is a must-have for the next batch?)

(第二条，可同日发) James — on your August question about a 2.5G/mGig PoE switch: yes. It is not on our published list (we publish the 10G/25G/100G CENTEC models), but on request we can supply a CENTEC 24 x 2.5/5G multi-gig PoE++ unit with 8 x 25G/10G SFP28 uplinks, dual hot-swap power modules and hot-swap fan modules, 1U rack (and a 24 x 10G multi-gig PoE++ version with 2 x 100G). Commercial temperature, L3 software. There is also a cheaper single-PSU path: 24 x 2.5G PoE++ (400 W) + 6 x 10G SFP+, L3, on our commercial Realtek line at $396 USD EXW. Want the datasheets, or is this a 2027 topic for SCOUT?

draft_en.body:
Hi, Stan,

You asked in June 2025 for OEM prices on the managed industrial PoE models (IGMP mandatory for your video-over-IP work). Here is the table, attached, for the models we discussed:

- STI-488XGGBPM — 8x GbE PoE + 4x 1G/2.5G/10G SFP+, internal booster PSU — $215 USD EXW/pc (quoted 1 Dec 2025, re-confirmed today, valid 15 days)
- STI-288DGGPM — 8x GbE PoE + 2x SFP, L2+ — $137.5 USD EXW (OEM tier on the sheet)
- STI-42424XGGPM — 24x GbE PoE + 4x 10G SFP+, L2+/L3 — $423.5 (L2+) / $517 (L3) USD EXW (OEM tier on the sheet)

All three: IGMP v2/v3 snooping + querier, OEM logo/model name/web GUI, neutral packaging, MOQ 50 for branded units.

One question: which two SKUs do you want to brand first for the Thor catalog?

Thank you.
Simon

draft_en.body:
Hi, Rex,

Your November request for spec and prices — here is the concrete answer:

- STI-488XGGBPM: 8x GbE PoE + 4x 1G/2.5G/10G SFP+, L2+ managed, internal power booster — $215 USD EXW in OEM lots (2026-10 price table, valid 15 days from this mail)
- Platforms we build on: Marvell AC5 (managed) and Realtek (entry); no Qualcomm/MTK.
- OEM: logo, model name, GUI, packaging from 50 pcs.

One question: is the booster-PoE managed unit for your own catalogue, or a project where I should quote a specific quantity?

Thank you.
Alan

draft_en.subject: Re: VXLAN / MPLS — CENTEC-based line
draft_en.body:
Hi, Kyle,

In April 2025 you asked whether our switches support VXLAN or MPLS, and Alan said no — that was true for the Marvell AC5 access line.

Our CENTEC-based line does: VXLAN/EVPN, BGP/OSPF, MPLS, MLAG, IPv6, managed by standard CLI/SNMP (no proprietary controller, so it fits whatever automation you run). Priced SKUs today:
- STH-8C48DX-HSI — 48x25G + 8x100G — $4,800 USD EXW
- STH-2C6QX-HSI — 6x40G + 2x100G, half-width — $1,200 USD EXW
- STH-32C-HSI — 32x100G — $6,000 USD EXW
(2026 Q2 list, MA license pre-installed, hot-swap PSU; valid 15 days.)

One question: which role would you test first — a 10G/25G aggregation box or a 100G spine?

Thank you.
Simon

draft_en.subject: Re: MOH-TA-170325 — 24-port industrial PoE x400
draft_en.body:
Hi, Hussain,

Last year you asked us to re-price the 24-port industrial L3 PoE (10G uplinks) x400 and the 8-port 2BT x100 for MOH-TA-170325, and later about outdoor-rated versions.

Two things from our side:
1. Volume: at 400 + 100 pcs we quote a volume tier, not the list price you saw in March 2025.
2. Outdoor: the switches stay -40 to +75 C rated; the outdoor part is an IP-rated cabinet with heater/fan, which we can supply with the switch pre-mounted.

One question: was the MOH tender awarded, and at roughly what unit price did the 24-port industrial PoE close? That tells me whether a volume tier would have won, and how to prepare the next one.

Thank you.
Simon

draft_en.subject: Re: 24-port PoE project — did it close, and what do current projects need?
draft_en.body:
Hi, Wadii,

In September 2024 we answered your 20-unit 24-port PoE RFQ (4x SFP, redundant PSU) with "not on our list" — too short an answer. In July 2025 you got the PSU costs (HDR-30-24 $15 / NDR-120-48 $25 / NDR-240-48 $40).

What we have today: 24x GbE PoE+ 280 W + 4x 10G SFP+, L2+, Marvell AC5 — $180 USD EXW, valid 15 days from this mail (our summer mail quoted $170; that batch is gone); single PSU, ERPS ring; a dual-PSU version is quoted on request.

One question: did the 2024 project close, and do your current projects still require dual PSU and stacking, or would 10G uplinks + ERPS do?

Thank you.
Alan

Hi Pete,

You opened our mail on "Managed Optical Bypass Switch" (and "Marvell Industrial Alert System") but had no reason to answer — fair enough. No brochure this time, just one question:

For the Dorani-branded 8- and 16-port PoE switches on your shop, we build Marvell-based PoE+ L2+ units under your label from small lots (neutral packing, RCM-ready documentation on request) — which one do you reorder more, the 8-port or the 16-port?

If it is not relevant now, a one-word reply is enough and I will take you off the catalog mails.

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom · sagatele.com

Hi Robin,

You opened our mail on "Industrial PoE Switch" (and "10G L3 Managed Switch") but had no reason to answer — fair enough. No brochure this time, just one question:

For the industrial switches in your projects, we supply Marvell-based DIN-rail 5-GE, 8-GE + 2 SFP and 8-PoE + 2 SFP managed units (−40~75 °C, CE/RoHS) from single units, EXW USD — which configuration do your Singapore installations use most?

draft_en.subject: One question — Mini Industrial PoE Switch
draft_en.body:
Hi Harshul,

You opened our mail on "Mini Industrial PoE Switch" (and "Commercial PoE Switch") but had no reason to answer — fair enough. No brochure this time, just one question:

For the tower and rooftop cabinets behind your LTE base stations, a −40 to +75 °C DIN 8-port PoE+ switch with 2 SFP uplinks (EION label possible) powers CPE and cameras from one box; would your channel partners want it on the price list?

If it is not relevant now, a one-word reply is enough and I will take you off the catalog mails.

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom · sagatele.com

Hi Anton,

You opened our mail on "Marvell Alleycat5 Solution" (and "Mini Industrial PoE Switch") but had no reason to answer — fair enough. No brochure this time, just one question:

For mining and plant-floor nodes where Westermo is over-spec — a Marvell-based managed DIN 8-PoE + 2-SFP (ERPS, −40~75 ℃, CE/FCC) at $79 EXW; not for rail or nuclear. Worth one evaluation unit?

If it is not relevant now, a one-word reply is enough and I will take you off the catalog mails.

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom · sagatele.com

research.summary: Zamość 一家 2002 年起的 ISP/安装商网店兼天线与光纤组件制造商（CBF 品牌），PLANET 商用交换机 5 款与 Moxa/Antaira 工业款同台在售。类型：分销/电商（2002 年起面向安装商与 ISP 的网络设备网店 + 自有天线/光纤品牌 CBF 制造；品牌 MikroTik / Ubiquiti / Moxa / Antaira / TP-Link / D-Link / Teltonika / Planet 等；PLANET 交换机 5 款 + 媒体转换器）。信号：cyberbajt.pl 商品页：PLANET WGS-4215-8P2S（1017.63 zł netto / 1251.68 zł brutto，「Towar będzie u Ciebie za 7 dni」）、WGSW-20160HP、GSD-804P、GSD-804（57.15 zł）、FSD-803（114.30 zł）、GT-805A 媒体转换器（168.22 zł）、IGTP-815AT 工业 PoE+ 媒体转换器；Urządzenia 与 Mediakonwertery 类目品牌筛选均含「Planet」。Planet 渠道档案 PB-069 评级 B（需求：PLANET 商用交换机 5 款有价有货期 + 工业线（Moxa/Antaira）在售 → 对 Saga 两条线都有真实槽位；触达：官网 dział handlowy 具名销售邮箱公开（Mikrotik 仓 R49 自官网抄录 6 位，本仓快照见 Michał Błaszczyk 具名）；体量：个体经营（Tadeusz Nowak）但自述「największy sklep internetowy dla instalatorów i operatorów ISP」+ 自有 CBF 品牌 → 可赢；Mikrotik 仓 A-512（人工 A ★★★，有邮箱）→ 并档，首触以 Mikrotik 仓库为准 → B ★★）。并档说明：该公司同时出现在 Saga 既有客户表（本条 SB-1176，波兰，未互动）与 Planet 渠道挖掘名单，首触邮件此前未发送。

research.website_status: 在线（danbit.dk；并档 Planet 渠道档案 PB-089）
research.summary: 丹麦 Køge 一家 1970 年起的工业 IT 分销商（瑞典有姊妹公司 Binär Teknik），把 PLANET 工业 PoE 管理交换机换上自家 ESW 货号卖，是典型的贴牌买家。类型：工业 IT / 网络专业分销商（1970 年起；6,000+ 特种产品，主要自台湾 / 中国 / 韩国 / 日本 / 美国进口；工业 PC、串口服务器、媒体转换器、工业交换机、PoE；自编货号 ESW- / ETH- / KAM- 贴牌销售，其中 ESW8G-M-SFP2(-PWM) 文案直接写「PLANET 智能 PoE 功能」）。信号：danbit.dk：PLANET IFT-802T 媒体转换器、PLANET POE-171S 分离器、Planet TDS-712 串口服务器、Planet IVS-H125P / IVS-2120 视频服务器（EOL）、CNV-SFP2.5G「designed to work with Planet products」、MGB SFP「可装于 PLANET Switch 产品」；binarteknik.se（同目录）：ESW8G-M-SFP2-PWM 4,462 SEK「industriell väggmonterad PoE Managed Switch med LCD-pekskärm med PLANET intelligenta PoE-funktioner」、ESW8G-M-SFP2 8,770 SEK「Industrial 8-Port Gigabit 802.3at PoE+ Switch … IP30 … <50 ms」、PLANET ICS-2105A / TDS-715。Planet 渠道档案 PB-089 评级 B（需求：PLANET 多类目在售（媒体转换器 / 串口服务器 / PoE 分离器 / SFP 兼容说明）+ 自编货号 ESW 系列工业 PoE 管理交换机文案含「PLANET 智能 PoE 功能」且「Fysiskt i lager」→ 工业交换机进货真实、贴牌习惯明确；触达：salg@danbit.dk + +45 56 66 20 20、Binär Teknik info@binarteknik.se 公开，无具名 KP；体量：1970 年起私营，6,000+ 产品，子公司于 PGJ Investments ApS，丹麦 + 瑞典 + 挪威 → 可赢；Gmail：Elsa 账号 2025-02-17 → 2026-08-13 以 BCC 群发 10 封（salg@danbit.dk / info@binarteknik.se），0 回复 → 非首触、通用通道疲劳；Mikrotik 仓无此户 → B ★★（贴牌买家画像强，无具名 KP + 群发疲劳不到 A））。并档说明：该公司同时出现在 Saga 既有客户表（本条 SB-1177，丹麦，未互动）与 Planet 渠道挖掘名单，首触邮件此前未发送。

Best regards,
Simon

draft_en.subject: Re: 24 Port PoE Managed Switch — one straight answer on API
draft_en.body:
Hi Christopher,

One straight answer I owe you from my Oct-4 mail: integration today is SNMP v2/v3 (standard + private MIB), scriptable SSH/CLI, and MQTT publish of port/PoE status from firmware 7.5 — there is no REST API or cloud controller. OEM customization (logo, model name, GUI, default config, packaging) is standard.

Which controller or NMS would you pair it with? With that I can confirm exactly what it can poll and set, and we can ship the 2 evaluation units ($180 USD EXW each, credited against a first order).

Best regards,
Simon

Hi, Peter,

You asked for prices in January and we did not come back properly — sorry for that.

CENTEC core/aggregation (L3, VXLAN/EVPN, MPLS, MLAG; MA license pre-installed; hot-swap PSU):
- STH-32C-HSI, 32x100G — $6,000 USD EXW

- STH-8C48DX-HSI, 48x25G + 8x100G — $4,800 USD EXW
(2026 Q2 list; valid 15 days from this mail.)

For the Volktek-class access range you sell: 24x1G + 4x10G SFP+ L2+ managed, PoE 280W — $180 USD EXW (the $170 in our summer mail was the previous batch), OEM label/GUI possible from 50 pcs (price per 2026-10 table, valid 15 days).

One question: is the first project a 10G/25G aggregation box or a 100G core?

Thank you.
Alan

Elsa

draft_en.subject: Re: MII / local content — what we can and cannot do
draft_en.body:
Dear Shantanu,

After our April exchange (industrial PoE at $35, AWB and delivery proof for India) the thread moved to WhatsApp with Simon. One point deserves a written answer: Make-in-India content.

What we can do: ship SKD kits for assembly by an Indian partner and progress to CKD as volumes justify it; firmware and web GUI under HFCL branding. What we cannot do: claim a Saga plant in India or certify a local-content percentage ourselves.

One question: which HFCL programme is this for, and what local-content percentage does that tender actually score? With that number we can tell you honestly whether the SKD route gets you there.

Best regards,
Elsa
Saga Telecom · sagatele.com

draft_en.subject: Re: OEM Core Switch — CENTEC 2026 prices
draft_en.body:
Hi, Marek,

Following your note in February about our CENTEC-based core/aggregation switches — here is what is fixed now, and what I would size for you.

1. 100G spine: STH-32C-HSI, 32x100G QSFP28, L3 (VXLAN/EVPN, BGP/OSPF, MPLS, MLAG, IPv6), 2x hot-swap PSU, MA license pre-installed — $6,000 USD EXW (2026 Q2 list, valid 15 days from this mail).
2. Compact leaf/spine: STH-2C6QX-HSI, 6x40G + 2x100G, half-width, dual-node — $1,200 USD EXW (same list, same validity).
3. 48x25G + 8x100G: STH-8C48DX-HSI — $4,800 USD EXW.

The 10G aggregation models (24x10G SFP+ class) are priced per project; if that is the layer you are sizing, tell me port count and uplink speed and I will quote those directly.

One question: which layer is the replacement for — 10G/25G aggregation or 100G spine?

Thank you.
Alan

Best regards,
Alan

Hi Ankara,

You opened our mail on "10G Enterprise SFP Switch" (and "Industrial PoE Switch") but had no reason to answer — fair enough. No brochure this time, just one question:

If it is not relevant now, a one-word reply is enough and I will take you off the catalog mails.

Best regards,
Alan

Best regards,
Alan

draft_en.body:

Best regards,
Alan

Hello,

Alongside the MikroTik and fiber lines you carry in Almaty, we supply Marvell-based DIN-rail 8-PoE + 2 SFP industrial switches (unmanaged and managed, −40~75 °C) in neutral packing from small lots, EXW — which industrial switch model do you ship most today?

Best regards,
Alan

Hi Golmar,

You opened our mail on "Managed Optical Bypass Switch" (and "48 Port PoE Managed Switch") but had no reason to answer — fair enough. No brochure this time, just one question:

Best regards,
Alan

Alan

Hello,

You opened our mail on "16 Port Ethernet Switch" (and "Managed Optical Bypass Switch") but had no reason to answer — fair enough. No brochure this time, just one question:

For the IP20 DIN-rail unmanaged and managed switches in your industrial-switch portfolio, we can serve as a second ODM source on a Marvell platform (8-GE + 2 SFP, 8-PoE + 2 SFP; −40~75 °C, CE/RoHS) from small lots in your housing — which configuration do your automation customers order most?

If it is not relevant now, a one-word reply is enough and I will take you off the catalog mails.

Best regards,
Alan

draft_en.subject: One question — Industrial PoE Switch
draft_en.body:
Hi Serkan,

You opened our mail on "Industrial PoE Switch" (and "Booster PoE Switch") but had no reason to answer — fair enough. No brochure this time, just one question:

For the industrial Ethernet switches offered under the Pavotek label in your IIoT solutions, we can supply Marvell-based DIN-rail 8-GE/8-PoE + 2 SFP managed units (−40~75 °C, redundant power, CE/RoHS) in your housing from small lots — which configuration do your industrial projects use most?

If it is not relevant now, a one-word reply is enough and I will take you off the catalog mails.

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom · sagatele.com

Michael,

Short answer to your June question: none of our models have rear-facing ports — ports are front, airflow front-to-rear on the CENTEC data-center units.

Alan Yan
Saga Telecom

draft_en.subject: Re: PoE / non-PoE price bands + ODM proposal
draft_en.body:
Hi, Peter,

Thank you for your note in November — price ranges for PoE / non-PoE access switches and an ODM proposal for the Korean ISP market. Attached: price bands and a one-page ODM scope.

- 8-port GbE PoE + 2x SFP, L2+ (STC-28DGGPM) — $87.4 USD EXW (2026-10 snapshot)
- 24-port GbE PoE 280W + 4x 10G SFP+, L2+ — $180 USD EXW
- 24-port GbE non-PoE + 4x 2.5G SFP, L2+ — $89.4 USD EXW
- ODM: your logo, model name, web GUI, packaging; MOQ 50 pcs per model; firmware OEM string changes included.
(All EXW Shenzhen, valid 15 days from this mail.)

One question: which ISP account would be the first fit, and is it PoE (cameras/APs) or non-PoE (FTTx CPE side)?

Thank you.
Alan

draft_en.subject: Re: vehicle network L3 requirement — PIM-SM now in firmware 7.5
draft_en.body:
Hi, Ender,

In February we had to say "problem" to PIM-SM/DM, RIPng/PBR and IP SLA for the vehicle container network. One of those has moved: PIM-SM is now available in firmware 7.5 (CLI). PIM-DM, RIPng, PBR and IP SLA are still not on the Marvell L3 units, and I will not pretend otherwise. They are all on our CENTEC STOS line (PIM-SM/DM, RIPng, PBR, IP SLA, BFD, VRRP — MS license), but that line is rated 0 to 40 C, so it only fits the container if the cabinet is climate-controlled.

Temperature: the industrial units are rated -40 to +75 C, so your -40 to +71 C spec is covered; the hardened enclosure stays on your side as discussed.

One question: does your end customer's multicast design actually require PIM-DM, or would PIM-SM be sufficient for the 2-4 switches per vehicle?

Thank you.
Alan

Best regards,
Alan

Hello,

Someone at NSI opened our June note on the 10G L3 managed switch (and earlier the industrial and booster PoE ones) but never had a reason to answer. No brochure this time, just one question:

If not, a one-word reply is enough and I will take you off the catalog mails.

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom · sagatele.com

draft_en.subject: One question — 24 Port Fiber Switch
draft_en.body:
Hi Abiel,

You opened our mail on "24 Port Fiber Switch" (and "Industrial PoE Switch") but had no reason to answer — fair enough. No brochure this time, just one question:

For the civilian LMSW managed switch range, we can be a second ODM source on a Marvell L2+ platform (8-PoE + 2 SFP, 24-GE + 4×10G, DIN-rail industrial 8-PoE) from small lots in your packaging, CE/RoHS — which LMSW model do you reorder most often?

If it is not relevant now, a one-word reply is enough and I will take you off the catalog mails.

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom · sagatele.com

Best regards,
Alan

Hello,

You opened our mail on "Industrial PoE Switch" (and "24 Port PoE Managed Switch") but had no reason to answer — fair enough. No brochure this time, just one question:

For the industrial PoE pages now filled with ONV units (4 fiber + 8 PoE managed, 4 PoE + 2 SFP web-smart), we supply the same port layouts on a Marvell platform (−40~75 °C, neutral packing) from small lots — which of the two layouts do your SI customers order more?

Best regards,
Alan

Best regards,
Alan

Hello,

Best regards,
Elsa
Saga Telecom · sagatele.com

draft_en.subject: Re: ANDA ATMIS series — the stacking point
draft_en.body:
Hi Subhash,

Following your 4 August note ("no a days Stacking is mandatory") — a straight answer rather than a datasheet:

Our AC5-based units do not offer Catalyst-style hardware stacking (no dedicated stack ports, no single-image chassis). Where stacking is a written requirement, we have the CENTEC-based STH-2QX4DX48GP (48 x 1G PoE++ + 4 x 25G + 2 x 40G) that stacks up to 8 units as one logical switch. On the AC5 access units, what you get instead is ERPS G.8032 rings (<20 ms) and 10G SFP+ uplinks, which is how most of our European integrators build the same redundancy.

So the one question: is stacking a written clause in your tenders, or an operations preference? If it is a clause, the STH-2QX4DX48GP is the unit to discuss (ANDA label possible); if it is a preference, I can map ATMIS-6208PI / 6216PI / 6408PI line by line to our industrial PoE models with your label.

Best regards,
Elsa
Saga Telecom · sagatele.com

Thank you.
Simon

draft_en.body:
Hi, Yair,

Coming back on the AT-GS910/24 replacement for your customer (47 pcs now, ~300 pcs/year).

- Price stays $60 USD/pc EXW Shenzhen as quoted on 15 Aug 2026 (valid 15 days from this mail); with your customer's $150 target there is room for freight, duty and your margin.

- We can ship 2 test units this month by DHL (paid samples, credited against the first 47).

One question: shall I prepare the sample invoice for 2 pcs, or do you want the 47-pc proforma directly?

Thank you.
Alan

Simon

Best regards,
Alan

draft_en.body:
Hi, Steve,

In August the six 400G units with QSFP112 modules were ready to ship, and you were updating your senior manager. Since then no news, which usually means the customer's budget moved.

The March price ($107,675 for 6 units + modules) was tied to that production batch; a new order is re-quoted on the current batch, so please do not plan on the old number.

One question: is the 400G project still on your customer's 2026 plan, or should we park it until their next budget cycle?

Thank you.
Alan

draft_en.body:
Hello,

You opened our mail on "Industrial PoE Switch" (and "10G L3 Managed Switch") but had no reason to answer — fair enough. No brochure this time, just one question:

For the VSS PoE switch range (W04POE2 / W08POE2G / W08GPOE2), we can supply the same port layouts under your label from small lots with a choice of housings, plus a Marvell-based gigabit L2+ 8-PoE step-up model — which VSS model do you reorder most often?

If it is not relevant now, a one-word reply is enough and I will take you off the catalog mails.

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom · sagatele.com

draft_en.subject: Re: 48 port stacking switches — the stackable line, properly this time
draft_en.body:
Hi, Greg,

In March I sent you one line and a PDF and called it done — that was too short after you had asked about stacking since 2024. Here is the proper answer against your January-2025 list.

The stackable platform is our CENTEC-based STH1G series, not the Marvell access switches (those will not stack, and I will not claim otherwise). It is a build-to-order line that we do not list publicly — lead time is confirmed per order, not the 3-5 days of the Marvell units:
- STH-2QX4DX48GP-HSI: 48 x 1G PoE++ (90 W/port, 1200 W dual hot-swap PSU) + 4 x 25G SFP28 + 2 x 40G QSFP+ (25G ports can run at 10G)
- Stacking: up to 8 units as one logical switch, ring or chain over the fiber ports, 360 Gbps stack bandwidth (Catalyst 9300-class StackWise-320 is the comparison your market will make)
- 10G copper access: the 48-port unit is 1G copper; the same family has a 40 x 2.5G + 8 x 10G multi-gig PoE++ model (STH-2QX4DX8XP40DP-HSI) with the same 4 x 25G + 2 x 40G uplinks — stacking on that model I will confirm before promising it
- L3 with OSPF/BGP/PIM, VXLAN-EVPN, MPLS, MACsec; Versitron logo, model name and SNMP strings on the unit
- Lighter version: STH-2QX4DX48GP-SFI (PoE+ 30 W, single PSU)

Pricing is by first-batch quantity, so I will not guess a number here.

One question: is the Cisco-alternative stackable line still on your 2027 plan, and if yes, how many units per stack and roughly how many stacks? With that I will send the EXW price the same day.

Thank you.
Simon

draft_en.subject: Re: 24-port SFP aggregation switch — one question
draft_en.body:
Hi, Casey,

Last October your team asked for the spec sheet and user manual of our 24-port SFP aggregation switch (4x 10G uplinks) and we sent both. Since then no feedback — which usually means something did not fit.

If it is useful: the industrial L3 24-port PoE with 4x 10G SFP+ (STI-42424XGGPM-4BT) was $500 USD EXW in April 2025; on the 2026-10 table it is $550 USD EXW (PCB/RAM costs and the exchange rate moved), valid 15 days from this mail; the aggregation SFP box is priced on request for OEM quantities.

One question: was there a specific gap — a feature, a certification (UL/NEBS), or price — that kept the 24-SFP unit off your list? A one-line answer is enough; it tells us whether to keep investing in Actelis.

Thank you.
Simon

Best regards,
Alan

Hello,

You opened our mail on "Passive PoE Switch" (and "Mini industrial switch") but had no reason to answer — fair enough. No brochure this time, just one question:

Best regards,
Simon

draft_en.subject: Re: Mini Industrial PoE Switch — the 3×GE PoE / Microfit board, one year later
draft_en.body:
Hi Elizabeth,

Last September we stopped at "we can develop it, but we need the quantity". Picking that up properly:

- Nearest ready unit for reference: a 4 x GE 802.3at PoE + 1 x GE uplink industrial switch, -40 to +75 C, IP40 (tested photos were in my September mail). A 3 x GE board-level version with a Microfit connector is a custom build on the same platform.
- Certifications up front: CE/FCC/RoHS/REACH/UKCA. We do not hold UL. If UL is mandatory for that outdoor cabinet, please tell me and we both save time.

One question: is the requirement still live, and roughly what annual quantity are we talking about? That is the one number the engineering evaluation needs.

Thank you.
Alan

draft_en.subject: Re: OEM Core Switching Solution — the data-center client
draft_en.body:
Dear Antonio,

In January you took our CENTEC material (STH25G series, function list V2.4) to a data-center client and kindly offered some feedback. I did not follow up on it, so let me do that now.

If the 25G/100G core is still open on their side: the 48 x 25G + 8 x 100G unit (STH-8C48DX-HSI) is $4,800 USD EXW on the 2026 Q2 list (valid 15 days from this mail), L3 with VXLAN-EVPN, MPLS and MLAG, hot-swap PSUs, with your label if needed.

One question: did the client decide, and if not, what was their feedback on the material?

Thank you.
Alan

draft_en.subject: Re: L2 managed switch — the L3 commercial model you asked for in 2024 exists now
draft_en.body:
Hi, Dmitry,

In June 2024 you asked for an L3 commercial switch with 8-12 SFP+ and 12-24 GE, and I had nothing exact. Today we do:

- 4 x 10G SFP+ + 16 x 1G SFP + 8 x GE combo, L3 (OSPF/RIP, static), 1U, Marvell — $392 USD EXW
- Industrial version with dual AC input (the one I quoted at $550 then): now $511.5 L2+ / $605 L3 on the 2026-10 list
(valid 15 days from this mail.)

One question: do you have a project this winter where one of these fits? If payment to Russia is the obstacle, tell me and I will explain the route we use.

Thank you.
Simon

draft_en.subject: Re: RFP (8/24/16-port PoE) — the prices we did not give in July
draft_en.body:
Hi Tarun,

In July you sent a clear RFP (100 × 8-port, 20 × 24-port, 100 × 16-port industrial L2+ PoE) and we answered with datasheets but no numbers. That was our mistake. Budget prices, USD EXW (2026-10-17 snapshot, valid 15 days):

- 8-port L2+ PoE 120W + 2× 2.5G SFP: STC-28DGGPM $84.1 (10G-uplink version on request)
- 24-port L2+ PoE 440W + 4× 10G SFP+: STC-424DGGPM-440W $220
- 16-port industrial L2+ PoE + 4× 10G SFP+, -40 to +75 °C: STI-21616XGGPM $310.2

The −48 V DC input (−32 to −78 V) on the 8-port is a project build, not a stock item.

One question: is the RFP still open, and which site / operator is it for?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom · sagatele.com

Simon

draft_en.subject: Re: OEM Core Switching Solution — STH-2QX4DX48GP-HSI vs C9300L-48P-4X, is the project still open?
draft_en.body:
Hi, Arnoldo,

In March we settled on the CENTEC-based STH-2QX4DX48GP-HSI as the stackable alternative to the C9300L-48P-4X, and I owe you a cleaner comparison than a datasheet:

- Access: 48 x 1G PoE++ (90 W per port, 1200 W dual hot-swap PSU) vs 48 x 1G PoE+ on the Cisco
- Uplinks: 4 x 25G SFP28 + 2 x 40G QSFP+ (25G ports can run at 10G) vs 4 x 10G SFP+
- Stacking: up to 8 units, ring or chain over the fiber ports, 360 Gbps vs StackWise-320
- Software: L3 with OSPF/BGP/PIM, VXLAN-EVPN, MPLS, MACsec, SNMP v3/CLI/Web; your own logo and model name on the unit

If the budget is tighter, the -SFI version (PoE+ 30 W, single PSU) is the lighter option.

One question: is the C9300L replacement still open, and roughly how many units (how many 8-unit stacks, how many sites)? With that I will give you the EXW unit price instead of a range.

Thank you.
Alan

draft_en.subject: Re: OEM Core Switching Solution — closing two loops from January
draft_en.body:
Hello Mark,

Two things from my January reply that I owe you a straight update on.

1. The management interface: I wrote that a RESTful API with JSON would be available in Q2. What shipped in the 2026/Q2 software is an RPC-based management API plus SNMP v3 and CLI — not REST/JSON. Please do not plan on REST from our side; I would rather say so than let the Q2 line stand.

2. 2.5G on SFP+: my "NO" was correct only for the CENTEC STH10G. On our Marvell AC5 line the SFP+ cages run at 1G/2.5G/10G (for example 24 x GbE + 4 x SFP+, or the industrial 8 x GbE + 4 x SFP+ at -40 to +75 C), and the DG models carry 1G/2.5G SFP. I should have said that in January. Copper ports on that line are 1G; if the requirement is multi-gig copper, we have two ways: the commercial Realtek line (8 x 2.5G PoE + 10G SFP web-managed at $66 USD EXW, 24 x 2.5G PoE++ L3 at $396 USD EXW, single PSU) or, on request and not on our published list, CENTEC-based 24/48 x 2.5G/5G/10G Base-T units with PoE++ and dual PSU.

One question: what is the application behind the 2.5G requirement — ONT/CPE uplinks, or something else? That tells me whether a sample (3-5 working days) is worth your time.

Thank you.
Alan

draft_en.subject: 48x25G + 8x100G and 32x100G — the two models you asked for in 2024
draft_en.body:
Hi, Yaroslav,

Two things I owe you from our December exchange.

Our website: https://sagatele.com/

And the two switches you asked about in May 2024 both exist now on our CENTEC-based line:
- STH-8C48DX-HSI: 48 x 25G SFP28 + 8 x 100G QSFP28, L3 with VXLAN-EVPN, MPLS, MLAG, hot-swap PSUs — $4,800 USD EXW
- STH-32C-HSI: 32 x 100G QSFP28 — $6,000 USD EXW
(2026 Q2 list, valid 15 days from this mail; your logo and model name possible.)

One question: when is the 100/25G project you mentioned in December due, and roughly how many units? With that I can confirm lead time and the payment route that works for you.

Thank you.
Alan

research.summary: 布鲁塞尔一家 1989 年起的 B2B IT 供应商兼电商，PLANET 品牌页以工业 IGS 系列为主、十余款带价。类型：B2B IT 硬件 / 软件供应商兼电商（1989 年成立；LinkedIn 11–50 人；自述「leading B2B supplier of hardware and software in Belgium」；多语站，PLANET 品牌页 /en/brand/7322/planet 下大量带价 SKU）。信号：redcorp.com：PLANET 品牌页 + 商品页带价：IGS-504PT € 230.42（已 fetch）；同页推荐 IGS-604HPT-RJ € 575.63 / IGS-4215-4P4T € 435.65 / IGS-4215-8P2T2S € 501.69 / IGS-20160HPT € 1033.86 / GSW-2620HP € 321.05 / IGS-824UPT € 362.27 / IGS-5225-4UP1T2S € 603.65 / IGS-6325-16P4S € 1132.28 / IGS-510TF € 147.10 / IGS-5225-8P4S € 669.78；搜索快照：GSW-2401 € 160.49「InStock」、ISW-501T € 80.32、GSW-1601 € 86.24、GSD-1002M € 126.55、WGS-804HP € 186.61、IGS-801M € 242.71、SGS-6341-24T4X € 559.49。Planet 渠道档案 PB-083 评级 B（需求：PLANET 品牌页 + 十余款工业 IGS 带价、GSW-2401「InStock」→ 在售真实，但价格形态（分位数）显示为分销 feed 定价、库存多数未显示；触达：sales@redcorp.com 公开（FAQ 页）+ 三位创始人具名直邮公开（About 页：ronald@ / dino@ / danny@redcorp.com），但创始人非采购 KP；体量：1989 年起、11–50 人，可赢；Gmail：Elsa 账号 2025-02-17 → 2026-08-13 以 BCC 群发 10 封至 sales@redcorp.com，0 回复 → 非首触、通用通道疲劳；Mikrotik 仓无此户 → B ★★（创始人直邮 + 工业线密集；feed 型 + 群发疲劳，不到 A））。并档说明：Saga 表内本条 SC-675（比利时）自动评 C（原因：；Saga 群发已推送 0 次无回复）。
